1	# Ordered EGZ in D_{2p}: proved components, dependency map, exact residual
2	
3	Lane MathOlson, 2026-10-16 (PDT).  Evidence labels: **[W]** written proof;
4	**[R]** independently reviewed (Codex, see receipts); **[C]** computer-checked
5	mechanism/construction (not a proof); **[F]** finite-exact exhaustive
6	computation.  Nothing here proves ordered Olson for every D_{2p}: Section 6
7	states the exact residual class that remains OPEN in this lane.
8	
9	## 0. Conventions
10	
11	p odd prime; D_{2p} = {(v,e)}, (v,e)(v',e') = (v + e v', e e'); rotations
12	rho_x = (x,+1), reflections sigma_y = (y,-1).  w is a word of length N; an
13	identity 2p-subword is an increasing index set of size 2p with ordered product
14	(0,+1).  Existence is invariant under cyclic rotation of w and under
15	automorphisms (rho_v -> rho_{uv}, sigma_v -> sigma_{uv+c}, u != 0).
16	
17	Gap model (F >= 1 reflections): cyclically w = X_1 f_1 X_2 f_2 ... X_F f_F,
18	f_t = sigma_{y_t}; X_t = block of n_t rotations before f_t ("gap t"); R = sum n_t.
19	Bracket product of gap t: beta_t = y_{t-1} - y_t - (sum of X_t).
20	Marked formulation (proof-theoremP.md, Steps 1-4): a colouring u of gaps
21	(u_t = 1 "Minus") with one gap fixed to 0 and marks m_r for rotations encode
22	every selection with an even number of reflections bijectively (reflection f_t
23	selected iff u_t != u_{t+1}; rotation r selected iff m_r XOR u_gap(r) = 1); the
24	ordered product is rho_V with V = sum_{t in Minus} beta_t + sum_{marked} x_r,
25	and the size is Z = #{colour changes} + #{selected rotations}.
26	
27	## 1. Lemma EGZ [W, classical]
28	If R >= 3p-1, an identity 2p-subword exists (2p rotations with zero sum).
29	
30	## 2. Theorem P [W][R][C]  (proof-theoremP.md; review/codex-theoremP/receipt.json)
31	If N <= 4p-1 and F + sum_t floor(n_t/2) >= 3p-1, an identity 2p-subword exists.
32	
33	## 3. Doubling Lemma [W][C]
34	Let N = 4p-1, F >= 1.  Let 0 <= j and a cyclic stretch of 2j+1 distinct
35	consecutive gaps t_0, ..., t_0+2j be given; call t_0+2i (i = 0..j) P-gaps and
36	t_0+2i-1 (i = 1..j) M-gaps.  Suppose a set K of rotations lying in P-gaps has
37	|K| = p - 2j - sum_{M-gaps} n_t >= 0 and
38	    sum_{M-gaps} beta_t + sum_{r in K} x_r = 0 (mod p).
39	Then w has an identity 2p-subword.
40	
41	Proof.  U := {f_{t-1}, f_t : t an M-gap} u {all rotations in M-gaps} u K.
42	|U| = 2j + sum n_M + |K| = p, and U is the selection with colouring "M-gaps
43	Minus, all other gaps Plus" and marks = K, so its product is rho_V with
44	V = sum_M beta_t + sum_K x = 0: U is an identity p-subword.
45	V-family: freeze all 2j+1 stretch gaps to Plus (one of them is the fixed gap);

rho_x = (x,+1), reflections sigma_y = (y,-1).  w is a word of length N; an
identity 2p-subword is an increasing index set of size 2p with ordered product
(0,+1).  Existence is invariant under cyclic rotation of w and under
automorphisms (rho_v -> rho_{uv}, sigma_v -> sigma_{uv+c}, u != 0).

Gap model (F >= 1 reflections): cyclically w = X_1 f_1 X_2 f_2 ... X_F f_F,

Marked formulation (proof-theoremP.md, Steps 1-4): a colouring u of gaps
(u_t = 1 "Minus") with one gap fixed to 0 and marks m_r for rotations encode

selected iff u_t != u_{t+1}; rotation r selected iff m_r XOR u_gap(r) = 1); the
ordered product is rho_V with V = sum_{t in Minus} beta_t + sum_{marked} x_r,
and the size is Z = #{colour changes} + #{selected rotations}.

If R >= 3p-1, an identity 2p-subword exists (2p rotations with zero sum).

## 3. Doubling Lemma [W][C]

    sum_{M-gaps} beta_t + sum_{r in K} x_r = 0 (mod p).

free parameters are the colours of the F-2j-1 other gaps and one mark for each
